test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer - General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2349ccb87e1487c9d8f636074a73c568bb2898480b7d7db220e6fcc084a6c5f0.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The corner elements of the first row interchange positions.

The top row center element is replaced by new element.

The second row elements shift clockwise.

The bottom row elements shift anticlockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c15cc52f6262d38d61b7b103654ddadaf81158fda312c9196484741d2c57b776.png] 

2) Second box series →

The center element is replaced by new element.

The rest of the elements shift clockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac4407d33e3b301371262fa2737213175fdb2645cfd58e558c5f7d35ff65691e.png] 

Thus, final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c27bb6acbfa07ed39cf93d0be9438dc071939c6835ad583543ed282adc84915d.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
